title: The Third Alibi
author: Jude Zhou
blurb: Yara Thornbury, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
